::: {#exm-surjective-or-not}
#### Surjective or not

A function is surjective (@def-surjective) exactly when its image (@def-image) is its whole codomain (@def-codomain).

- The function $\operatorname{len} : \set{0, 1}^* \to \Nat \cup \set{0}$ of @exm-injective-or-not is surjective:
  for each $n \ge 0$, the string of $n$ zeros has length $n$.
- The function $\operatorname{dup}$ of @exr-dup-odd is not surjective,
  since $010$ is not in its image (@sol-dup-odd).
- The function $\operatorname{len}_K$ of @exm-graph-length is not surjective,
  since no word of $K$ has length 5.

:::
